request.subject: ICON:TECH:DWARF:SEAMANSHIP

layers.text: Remove the two small white steam puffs. Make the water above the drill one thicker band of rolling pale blue-white waves with a curling white foam crest, spanning the top of the image, so the copper drill machine clearly bores along underneath the sea. Keep the drill machine's shape, its soot-black iron and copper, the size, the thick black outline and the style, on a transparent background.
